Gold states progression to mashed vegetables after initial soft foods. No generated fact clearly mentions progressing to mashed vegetables; closest are resume meat/eggs/fish after soft diet but not vegetables.
Gold: yogurts recommended as probiotics to help rebuild gut. Generated plan-007: 'yogurt OK (probiotic)'; benefit to gut recovery is implied but not explicitly stated; concept largely covered.

Gold: if diarrhea >1 week or blood appears, a stool sample will be required. The definite 'will be required' for stool sample on those specific criteria is softened to 'may require'; thus partially covered.

Gold: if >8 episodes and dehydration risk, book appointment. Generated plan-010: seek care if stools >6–8/day or >8/day due to dehydration risk, matches and even expands thresholds; core 'more than 8 with dehydration risk' is covered.
